data.raw_text:
[9:40PM] #Ogolonto #TrafficUpdate 

A good pace of vehicular movement is still being experienced from Haruno inward to Agric, Aunty Kenny, Idiroko, Ogoloto, Majindu, Orita Aje, and all the way to Itanwolo.

The return journey from Itanwolo back to Majindu is characterized by a steady movement, although a slow delay is observed when approaching Ogoloto Intersection, primarily due to traffic interchanges at Ogoloto Junction.

Movement towards Aunty Kenny is presently good, but approaching Agric, traffic is slow yet steady, largely attributed to commercial activities and pedestrian crossings.

Conversely, the stretch from Agric down to Haruno is experiencing a smooth traffic flow.

The road segment from Ogoloto inward Obasekumade Ferry Terminal is good, although traffic becomes momentarily congested when approaching Ebute Police Post.

However, from Ibese Roundabout all the way to Igbogbo, traffic is flowing smoothly in both inward and outward journeys.

Furthermore, the stretch from Ebute inward to General Hospital, Ojogbe, is good, but traffic slows down when approaching Ita Elewa, primarily due to traffic interchanges, though the situation is presently manageable.

As of this moment, no impediments to traffic flow have been recorded, and personnel are strategically deployed on ground, actively working to maintain traffic order.

#FollowLASTMA

[9:46PM] #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

The stretch on Eko Bridge, commencing from NEPA Intersection inward to Apongbon, is presently witnessing a satisfactory flow of traffic.

Descending Eko Bridge inward, and ascending CMS Bridge to connect CMS, is experiencing a smooth traffic movement.

Furthermore, the stretch from Carter Bridge descending inward to Ebute-Ero Market, Leventis, through UBA Roundabout, and connecting Inner and Outer Marina, is also proceeding without hindrance.

Notably, Broad Street stretch to Apongbon underneath the bridge, connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, is experiencing better movement.

Additionally, CMS Bridge stretch inward to Offin Canal Market, extending to Ijora Olopa by NEPA Intersection, is witnessing good traffic flow.

As of this moment, no impediments to traffic flow have been reported, indicating a favourable traffic situation within the area.

#FollowLASTMA
